monitorCpuWarning: CPU has remained at or above 90% for at least 30 seconds.
monitorDiskIoHelp: Rates are shown per device; logical volumes and their underlying devices are not added together. The first sample establishes a baseline.
monitorHistoryHelp: Charts show up to 5 minutes of samples from this connection. Paused, hidden and disconnected periods remain gaps.
monitorInodeHelp: A high inode usage means the filesystem may run out of file entries even when space remains.
monitorInodeWarning: {{mount}} inode usage is at or above 90%.
monitorLoadHelp: Load includes runnable tasks and tasks waiting in uninterruptible sleep. Compare it with the logical CPU count; it is not CPU utilization.
monitorMemoryWarning: Available memory is below 10% with sustained swap-out activity.
monitorNetworkCombined: Combined receive and send rate. See details for both directions.
monitorNetworkHelp: Whole-server interface traffic, not the traffic of this SSH or SFTP session. Rates require two samples.
monitorRulesHelp: CPU alerts require 30 seconds of continuous high usage. Memory alerts require low available memory with swap-out activity. Disk and inode alerts begin at 90%.
pluginsCpuHelp: Overall CPU usage between samples. The first sample establishes a baseline.
pluginsDelayed: Update delayed · data may be stale
pluginsMemoryHelp: Used memory = MemTotal − MemAvailable. Reclaimable cache is excluded.
name: Server resources
description: Monitor CPU, memory, disks and network on remote Linux servers, with a compact overview and detailed trends.
pluginsDiskHelp: Filesystem capacity by mount point. Capacity values use GiB.
